component: In-app notification shadow stylesheet palette roles

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The palette change introduces gray foreground/background aliases on the notification host and reuses them for text and close states. Each notification type supplies its own title, CTA, border, icon and gradient roles; blog/security retain dark or high-contrast overrides, and several literal colors remain. The actual shadow container loads this stylesheet and maps its type attribute to the subtype class. These are local palette/state relationships, not a global hex-color ban, proof of equivalent computed colors, or measured contrast/accessibility. No theme, focus, CSS or UI test ran.
title: Notification palettes share foreground and state aliases while keeping subtype overrides
